stemMd: Which temperature equals 27 °C approximately on the kelvin scale?
explanationMd: Kelvin temperature is Celsius temperature plus approximately 273. Thus 27 + 273 = 300 K. The scales have equally sized increments but different zero points.

distractorRationale.b: This subtracts the Celsius-Kelvin offset instead of adding it.
distractorRationale.a: This ignores the different zero points.
distractorRationale.d: This is approximately zero degrees Celsius.
distractorRationale.c: This uses an incorrect offset of three hundred.
